item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json,copy; from work import evaluate; requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); actual=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]; expected=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); cases=[({'declared':['b','a','b','ignored'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'same','meta':{'n':1}},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'extra':{'kind':'file'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'n':1},'hash':'same','kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'extra':{'kind':'other'}},},{'ignored':['ignored']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['b']}),({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),({'declared':['z','a'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'q'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'q'}},'current':{}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','z']})];\\nfor req,pol,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert req==rb and pol==pb\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
